input: Book a couples massage for our anniversary

gold.taskTitle: Book a Couples Massage for Your Anniversary
gold.taskDescription: Find and reserve a couples massage appointment at a suitable spa or wellness venue to celebrate an anniversary.

questions.title: What is the exact date of your anniversary?
questions.description: Identify the specific date the massage needs to be booked for.

questions.title: What city or area should the spa be in?
questions.description: Determine the geographic location to search for suitable venues.

questions.title: Do you have a preferred spa or venue in mind?
questions.description: Find out if the user already has a specific place they want to book, or if they need recommendations.

questions.title: What is your budget per person for the massage?
questions.description: Establish a price range to filter appropriate spa options.

questions.title: What type or length of massage do you want?
questions.description: Clarify the preferred massage style and session duration.

questions.title: What time of day works best for the appointment?
questions.description: Identify a preferred time slot so availability can be checked accordingly.

questions.title: Are there any add-ons or special requests to include?
questions.description: Determine if the user wants extras such as champagne, rose petals, aromatherapy, or accessibility needs.
